# ui::ArrangeContext

Header: `winui/ui/LayoutContext.hpp`.

What [Element::arrange()](element.md#arrange) hands arrange_override(): the measurer and theme the element was last measured with, so a container that measures again while arranging (a virtualizing list realizing rows) has them.

## measurer

```cpp
const TextMeasurer& measurer
```

The one the last measure() used.

## theme

```cpp
const Theme& theme
```

The theme in effect here, as the last measure() saw it.

## measure_context

```cpp
MeasureContext measure_context() const
```

The measure context for measuring children again from arrange_override().
